name: Kilnwall Wardens
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production 2D fantasy strategy game animated sprite source. True transparent RGBA background. Exactly four full-body poses of ONE original upgraded Brasshollow creature in a perfectly regular 2x2 grid with equal square cells, wide clear transparent gutters. Painterly richly textured fantasy unit art, weathered brass and soot-black iron, warm directional light. Right-facing three-quarter camera; same identity, design, equipment, proportions and scale in all four cells. Full body and all weapons visible with generous 8% margin EACH cell. Same planted feet/paws positions in every cell. Four genuinely articulated idle keyframes reading row-major, visibly different joint and equipment angles; no static duplicate cutouts. No text, caption, watermark, gridlines, checkerboard, environment, scenery, floor or platform.  CRITICAL LAYOUT: make sheet square 1536x1536. Each of 4 cells is768x768. Draw characters substantially SMALLER within cells: subject occupies at most 70% of cell height and width, leave a full100px EMPTY margin on ALL sides of each subject. Nothing may touch outer image boundary or central seams.Creature Kilnwall Wardens. ONE inseparable two-person unit: two stout furnace attendants with soot-black masks behind and beside one monumental iron kiln-door pavis shield, orange glowing narrow slots, thick triangular side braces. Both full attendants visible left and right of shield, a short poker held by right attendant. Idle poses: 1 left attendant forearm low gripping side brace, right poker down; 2 left attendant bends elbow raises bracing palm while right raises poker to waist; 3 left palm grips high and right bends poker arm further; 4 both arms settle halfway. Shield barely tilts, same two attendants, no additional characters.
reference_use: Original generation based on approved unit upgrade design brief.
